hint: Select any passage to explain it, look up its vocabulary, quiz yourself on it, translate it, highlight it or save it to your notebook.
pdfFallback: The original file could not be displayed, so this is the text AnyLearn extracted from it.

tutor.title: Tutor
tutor.empty: Select a passage and choose an action. The tutor answers from the passage you chose, and every answer can be saved to your notebook with its page.
tutor.videoEmpty: Choose a moment in the transcript and an action. The tutor answers from what is said around that moment.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.lead: What you save while reading, what the tutor writes for you, and your own notes. Each note remembers the page it came from, so it can take you back there.
notebook.empty: No notebooks yet. Saving anything from the reader creates your first one.
notebook.deleteConfirm: Delete this notebook and every note in it? This cannot be undone.

note.deleteConfirm: Delete this note? This cannot be undone.

videoHint: Choose a line of the transcript to play from it, then ask the tutor about that moment. The tutor hears only the words spoken in the minute either side; it cannot see the video.

passes.title: Five passes
passes.intro: Read this text five times, each time for one job: orient, map the structure, check the key evidence, rebuild it with everything closed, then put it to work. Your passes and the places you got stuck go into a reading evidence card for this document.
passes.allDone: All five passes are done. The retests on the card open on their days.
passes.rebuildRule: The text and the tutor are closed for this pass. Write from memory; they come back when you mark it done.
passes.closed: The text is put away while you rebuild it in the panel: problem, claim, evidence, limit and next action, in five sentences of your own. It comes back when you mark the pass done.
passes.barriersEmpty: Select the words that stopped you and choose "Mark a barrier".
passes.unavailable: This card no longer has its passes.
passes.stale: The card changed in another tab or from the toolbar. It has been reloaded; try again.
